summary: Implemented retry(operation, attempts, clock=None) in net/retry.py per docs/DECISIONS.md: total attempts including the first (D-4), ValueError for attempts < 1, waits from net.backoff.delays() through the injected Clock defaulting to SystemClock (D-1, D-2), only TransientError retried (D-3), last TransientError re-raised unchanged. Added tests for retry, backoff sequence and cap, error propagation, and validation; all 8 tests pass.
assumptions: Issue #41 says 'retry on any exception', but docs/DECISIONS.md D-3 says only TransientError is retried. I followed D-3 as the project's recorded policy; the conflict is flagged in questions_for_requester.
The stub's clock=None keyword is part of the existing signature and was kept; default is SystemClock().
No sleep after the final failed attempt (sleeps = attempts - 1), which matches 'waiting between attempts'.
Backoff uses net.backoff.delays() defaults (base 0.1, factor 2.0, cap 5.0) as the single project schedule (D-2).
The analysis was not written to ANALYSIS.md because writing analysis .md files is not permitted in this environment; the analysis is given in this report instead.
questions_for_requester: Should retry() retry on any exception as issue #41 says, or only TransientError as docs/DECISIONS.md D-3 records? The implementation currently follows D-3; switching to any exception means changing the except clause and updating D-3.
